source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of control structures (PDF 41).

blocks.text: Programming mein aksar program ka bahao (flow) sharait (conditions) ke mutabiq badalna parta hai, ya koi kaam kai baar dohrana parta hai. Yahan control structures kaam aate hain. In ki do bari qismein hain: decision making (faisla karna) aur looping (dohrana).

blocks.prompt: Control structures ki do bari qismein bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Decision making (if, if-else, if-elif-else) aur looping (while aur for loops).

items: Control structures: decision making (if waghera) aur looping (while, for).
